name: Komikado Ryouko
source:
An Inn's young okami and a widow.
Ryouko used to manage an inn together with her husband, but ever since he died she had to do it all alone. When working, she's firm and reliable, but when she's off she acts very leisurely.

She and Satoshi are in similar age and they used to be like siblings, with Ryouko being the older sister. She has a meddling and busybody personality.

Her getting married and becoming a widow, have both happened when Satoshi was away from the village.
